label: Generate and propagate per bit
subgoals: Compute the generate vector as a AND b
Compute the propagate vector as a XOR b
Classify each column as generate, propagate or kill

label: Unrolling the carry recurrence
subgoals: Substitute the carry recurrence into itself
Write each carry as an OR of generate terms gated by downstream propagates
Evaluate the carries from the given g, p and carry-in

label: Blocks and their delay
subgoals: Form group generate and group propagate for each block
Chain block carry-outs as G plus P times carry-in
Add the delays of g and p, each block, and the final XOR
